items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: He played with Vodakovich. ... I see Johnny Vodakovich.

ctx.x: I don't know if he's still there. Kinda Heavisett, Blackhead.

I'm trying to think of this. I'm trying to think of this. Well, in this guitar player, you look at him play right today, and you think about Ernest McClain 25 years ago. They have the same mannerism, he hold his guitar the same way, he don't move, but his fingers do the talking. That's the way Mac was. Man, he didn't do no movie. He just, oh dude, look at him. Do do do do do do do do do do do do do do do do. And this is the way it would. Oh, if I can think of his name. Bad as a guitar player I heard in this town,…
